test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

I bade him write the composition twice.

options.text: He was bid to write the composition twice.
He was baden to write the composition twice.
He was bade to write the composition twice.
He was bidden to write the composition twice.

solution:
"The correct answer is **'Option 4'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence "I bade him write the composition twice." is in active voice.
 
• In passive voice, the object of the sentence becomes the subject and the verb becomes passive.
 
• The past form of 'bade' in the passive voice is 'bidden'.
 
• Therefore, "He was bidden to write the composition twice." is the accurate conversion to the passive voice, corresponding to option 4.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 4."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: "He was bid to write the composition twice." This uses the incorrect past form of 'bade'.
 
• Option 2: "He was baden to write the composition twice." 'Baden' is not the correct past form of 'bade'.
 
• Option 3: "He was bade to write the composition twice." This still uses 'bade' which is not correct in the passive voice.
